verses.en: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.pt: Davi também fez casas para si em sua cidade, e preparou um lugar para a arca de Deus, e lhe armou uma tenda.
verses.en_web: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.
verses.en_bbe: And David made houses for himself in the town of David; and he got ready a place for the ark of God, and put up a tent for it.

verses.en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.pt: Então Davi disse: Ninguém pode trazer a arca de Deus, a não ser os levitas; porque o SENHOR os escolheu para que transportassem a arca do SENHOR, e para lhe servirem eternamente.
verses.en_web: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For Yahweh has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”
verses.en_bbe: Then David said, The ark of God may not be moved by any but the Levites, for they have been marked out by God to take the ark of God, and to do his work for ever.

verses.en: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.pt: E Davi ajuntou a todo Israel em Jerusalém, para fazerem subir a arca do SENHOR a seu lugar, que ele tinha lhe preparado.
verses.en_web: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up Yahweh’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.en_bbe: And David made all Israel come together at Jerusalem, to take the ark of the Lord to its place, which he had got ready for it.

verses.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.pt: Davi também ajuntou aos filhos de Arão e aos levitas:
verses.en_web: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:
verses.en_bbe: And David got together the sons of Aaron, and the Levites;

verses.en: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Coate, Uriel o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e vinte;
verses.en_web: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Kohath: Uriel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twenty;

verses.en: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Merari, Asaías o principal, e seus irmãos, duzentos e vinte;
verses.en_web: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Merari: Asaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred and twenty;

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Gérson, Joel o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e trinta;
verses.en_web: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Gershom: Joel the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and thirty;

verses.en: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Elisafã, Semaías o principal, e seus irmãos, duzentos;
verses.en_web: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers, two hundred;

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Hebrom, Eliel o principal, e seus irmãos, oitenta;
verses.en_web: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Hebron: Eliel the chief, and his brothers, eighty;

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.pt: Dos filhos de Uziel, Amidadabe o principal, e seus irmãos, cento e doze.
verses.en_web: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.
verses.en_bbe: Of the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab the chief, and his brothers, a hundred and twelve.

verses.en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.pt: E Davi chamou aos sacerdotes Zadoque e Abiatar, e a os levitas Uriel, Asaías, Joel, Semaías, Eliel, e Aminadabe;
verses.en_web: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.en_bbe: And David sent for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, Uriel, Asaiah and Joel, Shemaiah and Eliel and Amminadab,

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.pt: E disse-lhes: Vós que sois os chefes das famílias entre os levitas, santificai-vos, vós e vossos irmãos, e fazei subir a arca do SENHOR, Deus de Israel, ao lugar que eu lhe preparei;
verses.en_web: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.en_bbe: And said to them, You are the heads of the families of the Levites: make yourselves holy, you and your brothers, so that you may take the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel, to the place which I have made ready for it.

verses.en: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.pt: Pois por não terdes feito assim vós da primeira vez, o SENHOR nosso Deus fez nos atingiu, porque não o buscamos conforme o mandamento.
verses.en_web: For because you didn’t carry it at first, Yahweh our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”
verses.en_bbe: For because you did not take it at the first, the Lord our God sent punishment on us, because we did not get directions from him in the right way.

verses.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.pt: Assim os sacerdotes e os levitas se santificaram para trazerem a arca do SENHOR Deus de Israel.
verses.en_web: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of Yahweh, the God of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy to take up the ark of the Lord, the God of Israel.

verses.en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.pt: E os filhos dos levitas trouxeram a arca de Deus com as barras sobre seus ombros, assim como Moisés tinha mandado conforme a palavra do SENHOR.
verses.en_web: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to Yahweh’s word.
verses.en_bbe: And the sons of the Levites took up the ark of God, lifting it by its rods, as the Lord had said to Moses.

verses.en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.pt: E Davi disse aos chefes dos levitas que constituíssem de seus irmãos cantores com instrumentos musicais, com saltérios, e harpas, e címbalos; para que fizessem sons e levantassem a voz com alegria.
verses.en_web: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.
verses.en_bbe: And David gave orders to the chief of the Levites to put their brothers the music-makers in position, with instruments of music, corded instruments and brass, with glad voices making sounds of joy.

verses.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.pt: Então os levitas constituíram a Hemã, filho de Joel; e de seus irmãos, a Asafe filho de Berequias; e dos filhos de Merari e de seus irmãos, a Etã filho de Cusaías;
verses.en_web: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.en_bbe: So Heman, the son of Joel, and, of his brothers, Asaph, the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan, the son of Kushaiah, were put in position by the Levites;

verses.en: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.pt: E com eles a seus irmãos da segundo ordem, a Zacarias, Bene e Jaaziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Benaia, Maaseias, Matitias, Elifeleu, Micneias, Obede-Edom, e Jeiel, os porteiros.
verses.en_web: and with them their brothers of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.
verses.en_bbe: And with them their brothers of the second order, Zechariah, Bani and Jaaziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Unni, Eliab and Benaiah and Maaseiah and Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom and Jeiel, the door-keepers.

verses.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.pt: E os cantores: Hemã, Asafe, e Etã, fizeram sons com címbalos de metal.
verses.en_web: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of brass to sound aloud;
verses.en_bbe: So those who made melody, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were put in position, with brass instruments, sounding loudly;

verses.en: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.pt: E Zacarias, Aziel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Uni, Eliabe, Maaseias, e Benaia, com saltérios sobre Alamote.
verses.en_web: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;
verses.en_bbe: And Zechariah and Aziel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel, Unni and Eliab and Maaseiah and Benaiah, with corded instruments put to Alamoth.

verses.en: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.pt: E Matitias, Elifeleu, Micneias, Obede-Edom, Jeiel, e Azazias, tocavam ao modo de Seminite.
verses.en_web: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.
verses.en_bbe: And Mattithiah and Eliphelehu and Mikneiah and Obed-edom and Jeiel and Azaziah, with corded instruments on the octave, to give the first note of the song.

verses.en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.pt: E Quenanias, chefe dos levitas, estava encarregado de conduzir o cântico; ele ensinava o cântico porque era entendido.
verses.en_web: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.
verses.en_bbe: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was master of the music: he gave directions about the song, because he was expert.

verses.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.pt: E Berequias e Elcana eram porteiros da arca.
verses.en_web: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.en_bbe: And Berechiah and Elkanah were door-keepers for the ark.

verses.en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.pt: E os sacerdotes Sebanias, Josafá, Natanael, Amasai, Zacarias, Benaia, e Eliézer, tocavam as trombetas diante da arca de Deus; e Obede-Edom e Jeías eram porteiros da arca.
verses.en_web: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.en_bbe: And Shebaniah and Joshaphat and Nethanel and Amasai and Zechariah and Benaiah and Eliezer, the priests, made music on the horns before the ark of God; and Obed-edom and Jehiah were door-keepers for the ark.

verses.en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.pt: Sucedeu, pois, que Davi, os anciãos de Israel, e os capitães de milhares, foram fazer subir a arca do pacto do SENHOR, de casa de Obede-Edom, com alegria.
verses.en_web: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.
verses.en_bbe: So David, and the responsible men of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went with joy to get the ark of the agreement of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.pt: E foi que, por Deus estar ajudando os levitas que levavam a arca do pacto do SENHOR, eles sacrificaram sete novilhos e sete carneiros.
verses.en_web: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.
verses.en_bbe: And when God gave help to the Levites who were lifting up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, they made an offering of seven oxen and seven sheep.

verses.en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.pt: E Davi ia vestido de um roupão de linho fino, como também todos os levitas que levavam a arca, e os cantores; e Quenanias era o chefe da música e dos cantores. Davi também levava sobre si um éfode de linho.
verses.en_web: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.
verses.en_bbe: And David was clothed with a robe of fair linen, as were all the Levites who took up the ark, and those who made melody, and Chenaniah the master of those who made melody; and David had on a linen ephod;

verses.en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.pt: Assim todo Israel fez subir a arca do pacto do SENHOR, com júbilo, som de cornetas e trombetas, e címbalos, e ao som de saltérios e harpas.
verses.en_web: Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.
verses.en_bbe: So all Israel took up the ark of the agreement of the Lord, with loud cries and with horns and brass and corded instruments sounding loudly.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.pt: E foi que, quando a arca do pacto do SENHOR chegou à cidade de Davi, Mical, filha de Saul, olhou por uma janela, e viu o rei Davi dançando e saltando; e ela o desprezou em seu coração.
verses.en_web: As the ark of Yahweh’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.
verses.en_bbe: And when the ark of the agreement of the Lord came into the town of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looking out of the window, saw King David dancing and playing; and to her mind he seemed foolish.
